title: Simplify repo summary surfaces with progressive disclosure
specification:
# PRD: Simplify repo summary surfaces with progressive disclosure

Priority: medium

## Problem
Manager and repo summary surfaces still expose too much operational detail at once, which makes the default view hard to scan and unclear about what matters first for each repo.

## Goal
Make the default per-repo view minimal and high-signal, with deeper operational detail available only after opening the repo page or expanding a detail panel.

## Requirements
- Define a minimal default summary for manager repo cards and repo main surfaces that prioritizes repo identity, freshness, top status, active PRD state, and deploy/restart attention signals.
- Move secondary operational details such as GitHub validation metadata, package controls, live process internals, PID evidence, and detailed deployment/restart diagnostics behind the repo control page and/or explicit expanders.
- Keep the repo control page as the authoritative detailed surface for agents, pull requests, GitHub access, restart evidence, live process output, and raw status.
- Use progressive disclosure consistently so managers can scan many repos quickly before drilling into one repo.
- Preserve existing actions such as open repo control page, deploy, restart, package update, and PRD creation without changing their backend behavior.
- Ensure stale or conflicting states such as PR drift and failed GitHub validation still surface as concise attention labels in the minimal view rather than disappearing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Manager dashboard cards show a compact summary by default and are materially less dense than the current multi-section card layout.
- Opening a repo control page provides the fuller operational detail without losing existing actions or diagnostics.
- The repo main surface remains focused on current work/progress, while detailed status remains accessible in a clearly labeled deeper view.
- Failed GitHub validation, failed restart state, deploy available, and PR drift appear as concise summary signals in the default view.
- Existing control-plane actions continue to function with no backend contract changes.

## Verification
- Inspect manager and repo control-plane rendering paths to confirm summary fields and detailed fields are separated as intended.
- Add or update focused UI tests for compact manager cards and detailed repo drill-down behavior.
- Run `npm run typecheck`.
- Run relevant control-plane unit or smoke tests covering dashboard and repo-page rendering.
